description: Create a Sync (what Lucie Sync calls a scheduling poll; the app's "Find a time" button, formerly "group event") for a CALL or an IN-PERSON MEETING, where people vote on TIMES. Use it for "create a sync", "find a time with @sam", "set up coffee with…". For a trip, offsite, conference, retreat or any full-day or multi-day event, where people vote on DAYS, use create_trip_sync instead, not this tool. kind "call" (default) adds a Google Meet link when sent; kind "in_person_meeting" takes `place` and the organizer's `travelMinutes` each way, and only proposes times that leave room for the trip. durationMinutes can be any length up to 480; candidate times come from when every listed @handle is free for that whole length. Call it directly; don't pre-check with check_availability or find_group_times (those are for booking, in fixed lengths). The organizer's own calendar always counts; other participants' count if they have a Lucie @handle, and anyone else just votes on the link, so a missing handle never blocks a poll. Returns a vote link. Creates the poll only: no emails, no calendar writes. Confirm title, participants, kind, place and length with the organizer first. Sync Pro (or a Lucie Membership).

dates.description: trip only, REQUIRED: the candidate start days to offer, as YYYY-MM-DD, up to 10, e.g. ["2027-01-05","2027-01-12"]. Can be any distance ahead.

durationMinutes.description: call / in_person_meeting only: meeting length in minutes, ANY length up to 480 (e.g. 120 for a dinner); it doesn't have to be a length the participants' booking pages offer. Defaults to 30. Never use this for a trip: use tripDays.

from.description: ISO-8601 start of the search window.

handles.description: Other participants' Lucie @handles, if they have one, so their calendars count when picking times. The organizer's own handle is added automatically. People without a Lucie handle do NOT go here and don't block anything: they just vote on the link.

kind.description: Read first. "call" (default): people vote on times, Meet link added. "in_person_meeting": people vote on times at a place. For a trip or multi-day event use the create_trip_sync tool instead.

organizerName.description: The organizer's name (shown on the poll).

place.description: Where, for in_person_meeting or trip, e.g. "Blue Bottle, Mint Plaza, San Francisco" or "Lisbon". Shown to voters.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the poll's displayed times, e.g. "America/New_York". Defaults to UTC.

title.description: The meeting title, e.g. "Q3 planning sync".

to.description: ISO-8601 end of the search window.

travelMinutes.description: in_person_meeting only: the organizer's travel time EACH WAY, one of 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120. Only times leaving room for the trip are proposed, and the trip is blocked on their calendar once sent.

tripDays.description: trip only: how many days it lasts. Defaults to 1.

name: create_group_event
title: Find a time: create a Sync (a scheduling poll) seeded with everyone's common times
